author: mukmukfriend
body: Hey all, defense squad was an idea I thought of where a group of people would go on public nebula ''destroy the monument'' maps and join different teams to make op defenses and stalemate games. If your interested in doing this with me, add me on skype: mukmukzhou. I dont really care if your good/bad at avicus, as long as you dont do dumb things such as cover the monument and not listen.
